title: Priscilla McMillan revealed as CIA asset

tellings.quote: Priscilla McMillan who interviewed U Lee when he went to Russia and also befriended Marina Oswald and wrote her autobiography for her. Um she's a CIA agent. She's a witting CIA asset.

plain: A researcher named Jeremy Riss, on a Jesse Michels podcast episode about UFOs and the killing of President Kennedy, says that Priscilla McMillan, a writer who interviewed Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of shooting Kennedy, when he went to Russia, and who later befriended his wife Marina and wrote her life story, was a willing asset of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency. He ties this to the government's released Kennedy assassination files. If true, it would mean the CIA was closer to Oswald and his family than it let on.
